interned-domain-capture.description: InternedStrings/P5 S0 (A-Domain, IF-Capture): the hand-written `data.dictionaries.literal(col, s)` lets and their `__cq_parameter_N = &x` bindings are replaced by host-once A-Domain captures `let __cq_capture_N: StringCode = ::cq_storage::domain::exact(&(dictionaries.domain(col)), &(s)); let __cq_c_N = &__cq_capture_N;`; relational comparisons read __cq_c_N instead of __cq_parameter_N (renumbered); same codes, same predicates and operator order

interned-renumber.description: InternedStrings renumbering only: inserted capture bindings shift generated ordinals (__cq_parameter_N, __cq_rN_*, __cq_generated_N, ...); token streams equal modulo these ordinals

interned-h19-where.description: P5 S0 retail_h19: the opaque Rust `if` over code lets becomes one relational `where` over A-Domain captures and closed Decimal bounds; the plan and realization change (selection before the part join, no part_key fallback HashIndex), measured by exactness and paired timing

interned-typed.description: InternedStrings typed_* workloads: text columns are interned at load through a generated loader (`intern(.., &mut dictionaries)`) and decoded once at publication (`dictionaries.publish(col, code)`) instead of query-time `to_string`

interned-capture-handle.description: IF-Capture ownership: a `let` capture is bound as `let c = T-expr; let c = { use ::cq_storage::capture::{ShareArc as _, ShareCopy as _}; ::cq_storage::capture::Value::new(c).share() }; let p = &*c;` (Rust method resolution: a Copy value is its own handle, other values share one Arc) and every `move` closure that reads p (or c) owns `let c = Clone::clone(&c);` and rebinds `let p = &*c;` (own_captures), so a lazy answer no longer borrows the block-local capture and is not collected; parameter ordinals shift
